name: lingcoo-system-base-framework-workspace
description: Lingcoo Frame packages, reference applications and verification workspace.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-design-tokens && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-ui && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-extension-sdk && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-kernel && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-database && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-audit && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-fastify && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-opentelemetry && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-admin && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-web && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-identity && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-integrations && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-mail-nodemailer && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-storage-qiniu && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-ai-openrouter && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-payments && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-jobs && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-assets && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-presentation && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-notifications && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-cms && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/create-frame-app && npm run build --workspace @lingcootech/frame-example-extension
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:server && npm run build:admin && npm run build:public
scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:integration && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run check:opensource
scripts.version:packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-frame-version.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.release:canary: node scripts/prepare-canary.mjs && npm run build:packages && node scripts/publish-packages.mjs canary
